ruling.explanation: To the rider: your claim is not supported by the evidence, so the fare stands as charged. The trip you were billed for is not the trip you originally booked. The booking was Blk 118 Rivervale Drive to Changi Terminal 1, quoted at 21.0 km, and that is the 21 km figure you remember. You then moved the pickup to Punggol MRT at 07:12:30, and at 07:41:40 you asked in the chat to be taken to Terminal 3 instead of Terminal 1 (the driver acknowledged at 07:42:05); the trip record shows the dropoff amended at 07:41:52. Under POL-RD-05, once an endpoint is amended the POL-RD-01 comparison must be re-run against the platform's re-quote between the amended endpoints, and that stored figure is 24.60 km with a duration of 31.0 minutes. The 21.0 km estimate and the 24.8% deviation shown on the record and in the derived GPS block are both measured against the booking you changed, and both are superseded. Measured against the amended baseline, the governing distance is the GPS trace itself, 26.17 km (POL-RD-01: the trace governs over the 26.2 km rounded copy on the trip record and on the fare breakdown). That is an excess of 26.17 - 24.60 = 1.57 km, or 6.4% of the amended optimal. POL-RD-01 requires both more than 0.8 km absolute AND more than 20%; 6.4% fails the percentage gate, so no deviation is established and the metered fare is left as charged. Separately, distance driven before the 07:41:52 amendment is never counted as excess against the driver, and the T3 kerb circling within 400 m of the amended point is excluded as well where you were not at the pin, so the 1.57 km can only shrink, not grow. To the driver: your route is not faulted, and the amended-point looping you described is not counted against you. The GPS trace is clean for both schema and policy purposes: 206 fixes at a 10-second interval over 100% coverage with no gaps, so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07 and needs no independent corroboration. EV-ADVIS-00108-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; no road closure is claimed and none is needed, so it decides nothing. The fare reconciles to the cent (3.80 + 19.65 + 9.52 + 0.80 = 33.77), there are no ERP or toll lines to correct, and the airport surcharge is correctly 0.00 because this trip ended at Changi rather than originating there, so there is no billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4) and no referral. There is no repeat-deviation pattern to refer either: under POL-RD-06, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 402 completed trips in 90 days.
